Dag -
One of my favorite TV-shows of all time! It's dramacomedy about a psycho psychiatrist, looking to get his life back on track. The actors are amazing, and the show is amazing. I highly recommend watching it if you can find it with subtitles. Might still be on Norwegian Netflix, but I'm not sure.

Hodejegerne -
A movie adaption of the book by Jo. Nesbø, about a headhunter(aka. a talent hunter for a company) that has a side job as an art thief, and after many successfull robberies, he ends up stealing from someone he shouldn't. Overall a great performance by all the actors, and it's probably my favorite Norwegian movie so far.

Trolljegeren -
"A group of students investigates a series of mysterious bear killings, but learns that there are much more dangerous things going on. They start to follow a mysterious hunter, learning that he is actually a troll hunter." It's a found-footage movie, in the vein of Chronicles and The blair witch project. The acting isn't the best I've seen, but those who don't know the native language wont notice it. Overall a good plot and visually appealing.

Lange flate ballær -
A movie poking fun at people from Østfold(South-east Norway). Might be compared to the Hangover movies. Not the best movie in the world, but it's highly entertaining!

Kong curling -
Curling was really popular from 2010-2011 in Norway, so they made a comedy/satire movie about Norwegian curling teams. Decently funny.

Helt perfekt -
A TV-show about Thomas Giertsen, a famous Norwegian comedian, that plays as himself in a show based on the Danish TV-show Klovn that makes you cringe as much as The Office and It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia. I personally can't stand watching the show because I cringe so much, but it's still hilarious!

Fritt vilt -
Kind of cliche horror movie about teens on a skiing trip. Kinda spooky. The actors are actually pretty good, and it's not a cabin in the woods, but it is a cabin in the mountains, so I give it a 5-6/10.
My favorite Norwegian movies and TV-shows.

Hodejegerne - can confirm, one of my top movies seen last year

The rest I don't know which makes them a to-do project, Thanks for sharing!
